item.description: ### Improved - **Approvals show the whole command.** Your Mac notification, iPhone and Apple Watch used to show only the first line of a command, cut at 60 characters, so a command with several lines looked like just its first. Now the full command is sent for Claude Code, Codex and Devin, up to 4 KB. Hidden characters that could disguise a command are shown as codes. The iPhone and Apple Watch show the full command after their next update. - **No one-tap Allow on a command your notification can't show in full.** When a command is longer than a notification can show, the Mac notification offers Deny and "Review in terminal" instead of Allow, and the iPhone lock screen opens the full request in the app instead of offering Allow.
